summary: Adds a structured Fresha venue-menu source to Web Scraper (HEAD f4fedcc): `utils/freshaVenue.ts` (pure link detection + `__NEXT_DATA__` → rows), `services/freshaVenueService.ts` (one Jina HTML-mode fetch, 45 s timeout), and the wiring in `WebScraperTab.tsx`, with a fixed-column export plus a `Not on venue page` note sheet. The work follows the existing Yalla menu pattern exactly — pure utils, I/O in services, fail-soft fallback to the page-text route — and is backed by a real captured fixture, 15 unit tests and 4 offline e2e tests. External JSON is validated field-by-field (`isObj`, `Array.isArray`, typeof guards) rather than asserted, the venue URL is rebuilt from a `[A-Za-z0-9-]+` slug so nothing user-supplied reaches the fetch path unescaped, and no new dependency or top-level directory is introduced. No blocking findings; one low-severity counter inconsistency and two informational notes.
